query:
UPDATE tasks
                    SET task_status = CASE WHEN task_status = 'running' THEN $2 ELSE $5 END,
                        last_event_id = $3
                    WHERE task_id = $1 AND (
                        last_event_id IS NULL AND CAST($4 as INT8) IS NULL OR
                        last_event_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST($4 as INT8) IS NOT NULL AND last_event_id = $4
                    )
                    RETURNING task_id
